steps.path: Conversations, project guidance, actions, and connections
steps.headline: Accept the 17 verified requirements, with process-group stopping explicitly deferred?
steps.notice: 17 requirements passed their checks. R17 is intentionally not passed: you deferred the larger process-stopping change. Native question answers are fixed; Claude Code keeps its existing behavior. These are completed worktree changes, not a release.
steps.risk: Item 10 stays excluded. Unapproved audit findings are not bundled in. No release, live-app changes or paid evaluation is authorized by this sign-off.
